name: Vulnerabilities
summary: Adversaries may acquire information about vulnerabilities that can be used during targeting. A vulnerability is a weakness in computer hardware or software that can, potentially, be exploited by an adversary to cause unintended or unanticipated behavior to occur. Adversaries may find vulnerability information by searching open databases or gaining access to closed vulnerability databases. An adversary may monitor vulnerability…

analytics.name: Analytic 1940
analytics.guidance: Much of this activity will take place outside the visibility of the target organization, making detection of this behavior difficult. Detection efforts may be focused on behaviors relating to the potential use of exploits for vulnerabilities (i.e. Exploit Public-Facing Application, Exploitation for Client Execution, Exploitation for Privilege Escalation, Exploitation for Stealth, Exploitation for Credential Access, Exploitation of Remote Services, and Application or System Exploitation).

telemetry.basis: ATT&CK detects relationship → detection strategy → analytic → log-source component reference
telemetry.planning_note: The upstream guidance describes limited target visibility. These are conditional investigation inputs, not direct victim-side detection of preparation. Simulator-side logs do not prove defender visibility.
